en.h1: Resize video without stretching the picture

en.why: Resolution should match where the video will actually be seen
en.note: The resizer preserves aspect ratio and calculates the matching height automatically. Upscaling a small source does not create real detail, so choose a width at or below the original whenever possible.

en.h1: Merge several video clips into one file, in the order you choose

en.title: Video to GIF Online – Make a GIF from a Clip | DJAI
en.meta: Turn part of a video into a GIF online. Choose start and end time, width and frame rate, preview the clip and create the GIF in your browser.
en.h1: Turn the useful few seconds of a video into a GIF
en.hero: Do not convert the whole video when the reaction, demo or loop lives in six seconds. Mark the exact range, choose a practical width and frame rate, then build the GIF locally.
en.why: A good GIF is usually a short decision, not a full-video conversion
en.note: GIF is convenient but not an efficient video format. Keep the clip short and dimensions sensible. For longer motion, MP4 or WebM will usually look better at a much smaller file size.
